- **Acceptance Criteria (`AC-1` through `AC-7`):**
  - **AC-1 (`Kind: happy`)** — Initiate Google OIDC login (`GET /api/v1/auth/login`) and exchange callback code (`GET /api/v1/auth/callback`) with strict JWT claim/signature validation (`iss`, `aud`, `exp`, `nbf`, `kid`, algorithm allowlist rejecting `alg: none`), PostgreSQL user upsert, active role/permission resolution, Redis session storage via [`SessionStorePort.storeSession`](file:///home/e2e/agents-v0-e2e/run-20261029-1629/work/portal/app/backend/src/main/java/com/example/app/iam/port/SessionStorePort.java#L8), `AUTH_LOGIN_SUCCESS` audit entry (`Encode.forJava()`), and `HTTP 302` redirect with `HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax` cookie.
